title: Langley drones were targeting NASA and a specific base location
place_text: Langley Air Force Base / NASA Langley, Virginia

tellings.quote: those drones were really targeting primarily NASA and then a very specific location on Langley Air Force Base

plain: The drones seen over Langley Air Force Base in Virginia in 2023 were not wandering at random but were aimed mainly at NASA's site there and then at 'a very specific location' on the base. So says Dylan Borland, a guest who speaks as someone with first-hand knowledge. If he is right, whoever flew them knew exactly what they wanted to look at, though he does not say on the show what that location was.
